reference.code:
package solution
func KeepLast(v []string)[]string{seen:=map[string]bool{};r:=[]string{};for i:=len(v)-1;i>=0;i--{if !seen[v[i]]{seen[v[i]]=true;r=append(r,v[i])}};out:=make([]string,len(r));for i:=range r{out[len(r)-1-i]=r[i]};return out}
